decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Signs 2 and 12 at the Essex Place road frontage shall be setback at least 2.4m from the Give Way Sign as shown on the plan CHQ.08.8383-014-A, Received 07 January 2009.

Condition : 4 - All advertisements displayed, and any land or building used for the purpose of its display, shall be maintained in a reasonably clean and tidy condition so that it does not impair the visual amenity of the site.
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding used for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition so that it does not endanger the public.

Condition : 6 - Where any advertisement is required to be removed, the removal shall leave the site in a safe condition that does not endanger the public, and in a reasonably clean and tidy condition so that it does not impair the site's visual amenity.
Condition : 7 - The totem pole sign hereby approved shall not have a luminance that exceeds 600cd/m?.

Condition : 8 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed that would endanger anyone using the highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military) or would obscure or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal, or aid to navigation by water or air. It also prohibits the siting or display of an advertisement that would hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance (such as closed circuit television cameras) or for measuring the speed of any vehicle (speed cameras or other speed-measuring devices).

Condition : 9 - No advertisement shall be displayed without the consent of the owner of the site (this includes lands or buildings where the advertisement is displayed), nor the permission of any other person with an interest in the land entitled to give permission.
description: Installation of internally illuminated signs to the existing car park at Sainsbury's retail store.
